description: The M1 jump for the UDIRC 1610S (Unity engine): speed mode at 1880 rad/s motor (~7 m/s) to the lip and through the flight (wheels keep spinning, so no reaction torque on the chassis), then speed-mode brake to 0 after landing (t = 3.4 s). Braking the wheels in the air pitches the car nose-down (the M4 effect) and full torque (06) overshoots the landing with the light car.
